question.text: A Category III AIF wishes to change certain terms of its PPM. Within what timeline must it intimate SEBI on a consolidated basis?

answer.text: Within 1 month of the end of each financial year
At the end of the fund tenure

explanation.text: The Logic: Changes to PPM terms must be intimated to SEBI on a consolidated basis within 1 month of the end of each financial year, through a Merchant Banker with a due diligence certificate. The Trap: Single-event 7-day reporting applies only to specific items like control change, not general PPM changes. 3 months and end-of-tenure are wrong. Cross-Exam Context: Same consolidated annual intimation regime applies to Cat I/II AIFs (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain a live 'PPM change log' internally so the consolidated annual intimation is accurate and complete.
